issue.title: Визуал попытки входа в папки куда у нас доступа нет

llm_context.input_title: Визуал попытки входа в папки куда у нас доступа нет
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: On Windows, when a user attempts to enter a directory to which they do not have access permission, the application incorrectly flashes a visual indication as if it successfully entered and exited the directory, subsequently showing an 'Access Denied' error. FAR3 behaves correctly by preventing the visual entry attempt.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The directory navigation or file open handler attempts to process the directory change or read operation before validating sufficient access permissions, or handles the permission failure after updating the view state.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect Directory Access Handling in vfs/sudo_client.go
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine the Open symbol and directory navigation handler in vfs/sudo_client.go to understand where the view state is modified prior to permission validation on Windows.

step_by_step_plan.title: Validate Permissions Prior to View State Update
step_by_step_plan.description: Modify the navigation logic in vfs/sudo_client.go so that access permissions are checked and verified before any visual directory transition or view state update occurs.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement Windows Access Denied Regression Test
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a dedicated test case in vfs/sudo_client_windows_test.go simulating restricted directory access to ensure no false visual entry state or erroneous UI flashing occurs.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Test Suite to Verify Fix
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the test command to verify that restricted directory access properly surfaces the Access Denied error without triggering intermediate directory transition visuals.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Validating user permissions before updating UI state or navigation paths.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Ensures the application state remains synchronized with actual OS permissions and prevents misleading visual feedback to users.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Fixes the premature UI state change when encountering access denied errors on Windows folders.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Adapting file system operations and error reporting to OS-specific behaviors (such as Windows ACLs versus Unix permissions).
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Different operating systems report permission denials differently, requiring robust platform-aware handling.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Addresses the specific bug reported under Windows where restricted folder access causes incorrect visual entry.

common_pitfalls: Modifying platform-agnostic navigation code without considering Windows-specific file system error codes.
Updating the current working directory or view state before verifying that the target directory can be successfully read.
